purpose: What kind of training, guidance or support a document says the institution offers on AI. One row per document per form, each with a verbatim quote, a requirement level and an audience.

forms.label: Course, module or e-learning unit
forms.definition: A structured course, VLE module, e-learning unit or external course (for example a FutureLearn or Jisc programme) on AI.
forms.rule: Use when the quote names or describes a course, module, e-learning or programme of study on AI. Not this: a quiz or test with a badge (quiz_test_or_badge); a single live session (workshop_or_live_session); a written guide or hub page, even if hosted on the VLE (guide_toolkit_or_hub).

forms.label: Quiz, test, badge or certificate
forms.definition: A short test, quiz, integrity test, badge or certificate that students complete.
forms.rule: Use when the quote names a quiz, test, assessment, badge or certificate on AI or academic integrity. If the same quote also names a course, record both forms.

forms.label: Workshop, webinar or live session
forms.definition: Scheduled live sessions, workshops, webinars or training events.
forms.rule: Use when the quote describes live or scheduled sessions (workshops, webinars, drop-ins, talks). Not this: open-access self-study material.

forms.label: Guide, toolkit, checklist or resource hub
forms.definition: A written or video guide, toolkit, checklist, FAQ, tutorial or resource hub on AI, whoever produced it.
forms.rule: Use when the quote points to guidance material (a guide, student guide, toolkit, checklist, FAQ, videos, Padlet board, LibGuide on AI). Not this: only a referencing guide (referencing_help); only a prompt collection or how-to for a named tool (prompt_bank_or_tool_howto); a bare link label with no description still counts if the label itself names AI guidance.

forms.label: Prompt bank or how-to for a tool
forms.definition: A prompt library or bank, prompting advice, or training or help on using a named AI tool.
forms.rule: Use when the quote offers example prompts, a prompt library, how-to-prompt advice, or training on a specific named tool (Copilot, EndNote AI features). Not this: general AI guidance (guide_toolkit_or_hub).

forms.label: Help with referencing or acknowledging AI
forms.definition: A referencing guide, reference builder, video or advice on citing or acknowledging AI.
forms.rule: Use when the quote offers help with citing, referencing or acknowledging AI use (library referencing guide, reference builder, video, cover-sheet help). Not this: the duty to reference (reference_ai_use_with_citation); the citation format itself (ai_reference_format_or_personal_communication).

forms.label: Named academic, library or skills support
forms.definition: A named person, team or service that students can ask about AI or its use in study (library, skills centre, learning development, writing support, tutors, language support).
forms.rule: Use when the quote names a person, team or service (liaison librarian, skills advisor, writing support, academic mentor, personal tutor, learning centre, English language support) as a source of help with AI or academic practice linked to AI. Not this: staff-only teams; a generic instruction to ask the tutor about permission (ask_tutor_when_unsure) unless the tutor is presented as a source of support.

forms.label: Disability, wellbeing or safeguarding support
forms.definition: A disability adviser, counselling, wellbeing or safeguarding service named in connection with AI.
forms.rule: Use when the quote names disability, mental-health, counselling, wellbeing or safeguarding support in an AI context (AI as an adjustment, distress from AI use, support for anxious students).

forms.label: Support for students in a misconduct case
forms.definition: Advice or representation for students accused of AI misuse (students' union or advice centre, named adviser).
forms.rule: Use when the quote names a service or person who advises or supports students accused of inappropriate AI use.

forms.label: Training or support for staff
forms.definition: Training, guidance or support aimed at staff or at staff and students together.
forms.rule: Use when the quote offers training, workshops or guidance to staff on AI (including staff and student services). Record the audience as staff or both. If the quote is only about students, do not use this form.

requirement.mandatory: students (or staff) must complete or use it; required before use or before an assessment.
requirement.advised: strongly recommended, expected, or auto-enrolled but not stated as compulsory (should complete, are encouraged to, is recommended).
requirement.optional: available to use; no expectation stated.
requirement.planned: the institution says it will provide it, commits to providing it or is developing it.

audience.both: offered to staff and students together
